messages.subject: Rony | Saudi Executive Profile | Country Leadership, Government Relations & ESG
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Nassar,

I am sharing my profile for senior leadership mandates in Saudi Arabia across mining, industrials, energy transition and government-facing corporate functions.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

As Managing Partner for InterSearch Saudi Arabia, with deep experience in senior and board-level appointments across the Kingdom, your remit aligns closely with the direction of my next move. My strongest value sits where a business needs a senior leader who can connect operations with government, regulators, communities, investors and sustainability priorities.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and Country Leadership.

Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority. I have attached a Saudi-focused executive CV for confidential consideration and am available on 30 days' notice.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
